claims.text: Either party may terminate the Agreement for convenience, without cause, on ninety (90) days written notice to the other party.

citations.quote: This Agreement may be canceled at any time without cause, by either party upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other party.

claims.text: The same no-cause termination right is restated later in Section 15.B, again allowing either party to terminate without cause on ninety (90) days written notice.

citations.quote: This Agreement may be terminated at any time without cause by either party upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other party.

claims.text: The no-cause termination right sits alongside the Agreement's one-year term, which renews automatically unless terminated as provided below.

citations.quote: will automatically renew for successive one (1) year periods unless terminated as provided below.
